title: Military Service Hold Review Proof — Stage Cut
content:
**Legal liaison schedule — Hardship and Protective Holds.** When current proof of active military duty is asked for before a status review of a running Military Service Hold, the proof stage cut depends on the held account's placement stage, as shown in its Placed Consumer Accounts record. The cut is subtracted once from the days allowed for the status review proof.

| Placement stage of the held account | Proof stage cut |
|---|---|
| Legal Review Placement | 10 calendar days (legal cut days), because any stay of proceedings needs current proof |
| Tertiary Placement or Warehouse Placement | 5 calendar days (late-stage cut days) |
| Early-Out Placement, Primary Placement or Secondary Placement | Nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** The held account is at Legal Review Placement: 10 calendar days are cut. At Primary Placement: nothing is cut.
